## Summary

One or two sentences. What changes, and why.

## Scope

- [ ] One concern per PR (no bundled refactor + dep bump + behavior change)
- [ ] Linked issue: #
- [ ] Aligned with `COMPATIBILITY.md` (no undeclared public-API change)

## Test plan

- [ ] `mvn test` passes locally
- [ ] New tests cover the change (or rationale below)
- [ ] No behavior change observable from the public API, OR migration note added

## Documentation

- [ ] README / quickstart updated if user-visible
- [ ] ADR added or updated if architectural
- [ ] Migration guide updated if breaking

## Rollback

If this lands and needs to be reverted, what's the blast radius?
